target: DGX Spark native ARM64 CARLA, sensors and Autoware
status_policy: Planned tasks and passing harness fixtures do not establish product acceptance.
existing_tools_policy: These commands are existing helpers, not completion recipes. In particular carla-editor-check uses UBT -SkipBuild, not a real Editor build.
dependency_policy: Dependencies gate acceptance and promotion. Disjoint code preparation may overlap; a prerequisite never becomes PASS merely because a dependent task started.

tasks.title: Retain the complete local source changes
acceptance: Capture all three repository HEADs and tracked binary patches.
Retain untracked file content and executable mode, not only hashes.
Verify both retained snapshots and live inputs; reject missing or changed content.
Document source.lock drift without silently changing its pins.

tasks.title: Finish static Interchange contracts and connect the parser facade
acceptance: Run all scene self-checks and export every requested mesh payload.
Resolve payload keys with transform-aware identity and explicit errors.
Exercise multiple meshes, hierarchy, instance overrides, mirrored transforms and rejection cases.
Connect the real parser facade; test worker transport and consumer format separately.
Keep material shading, animation and export marked incomplete until their own tests pass.

tasks.title: Rebuild and integrate the pinned USD dependency set
acceptance: Reduce inventory entries to a component dependency graph; distinguish missing files from selection-rule errors.
Rebuild pinned native dependencies into separate artifact prefixes.
Verify architecture, PIC where required, C++ ABI, link/load and Python 3.11 bindings.
Build OpenUSD 24.05 with the relevant UE patches and validate actual plugin resource loading.
Submit UE rule changes for main-agent integration without overwriting existing SDK paths.

tasks.title: Migrate reachable Legacy importer/exporter SDK consumers
acceptance: Freeze the required CARLA asset/import/reimport/export feature matrix.
Determine enabled consumers using actual target/build evidence, not lexical counts.
Replace public SDK-shaped interfaces and update their callers.
Test required static, material, collision, LOD, skeletal, morph, animation and export workflows.
Remove SDK build edges only after the relevant implementations and callers are migrated.
does_not_prove: disabled or stubbed functionality has parity

tasks.title: Build and launch the native Editor
acceptance: Run a real native Editor build, not only UBT -SkipBuild.
Launch commandlets and load the CARLA project without unresolved dependencies.
Record architecture, dynamic libraries, source changes and complete logs.

tasks.title: Cook a minimal map and launch a complete native CARLA package
acceptance: Cook the LinuxArm64 Game target with matching project assets and Vulkan formats.
Stage the actual binaries, libraries, Asset Registry, shader data, ICU and content.
Complete version/world RPC and at least 100 consecutive synchronous ticks.
Do not replace the rendering-capable Game target with a dedicated non-rendering Server target.

tasks.title: Verify UE rendering and real sensor delivery
write_scope: runtime tests and fixtures assigned at activation
acceptance: Use actual GB10 Vulkan rendering and an inspectable scene.
Check nonconstant/changing RGB frames and finite nonempty LiDAR data.
Match frame IDs and simulation timestamps; verify cleanup and stability.
Choose measured performance thresholds after obtaining the first real sensor baseline.
does_not_prove: Vulkan clear/readback alone is CARLA rendering

tasks.title: Integrate the bridge and Autoware closed loop
write_scope: bridge and Autoware changes assigned at activation
acceptance: Verify or port ACB from its 0.9.16 baseline to the actual CARLA 0.10 server.
Choose one clock/TF/vehicle-control publisher path per profile.
Validate maps, sensor extrinsics, QoS, localization, planning and vehicle control.
Complete a repeatable drive-to-goal test with recorded ground truth.
does_not_prove: a topic list or open port is a closed loop

tasks.title: Prove clean rebuild and one-click regression
acceptance: Replay the effective source baseline in a separate clean checkout.
Rebuild the Docker environment and artifacts without hidden local SDK copies.
Run the product gates again and retain reproducible A/A and A/B evidence.
Publish one entrypoint only after its whole dependency chain is proven.
does_not_prove: a manifest alone is a clean rebuild
